review:
The Bonanza Billion sequel, mixing fruit with glowing crystals in a bright, phone-friendly design. The big change: multiplier symbols worth 2x to 500x can land in the base game too, not just the bonus.

Four scatters give 15 free spins (three more add five), and in the bonus the multipliers build up across winning spins instead of resetting. There are three buy options, two of which start you with a 50x or 100x multiplier. High volatility, a 5,000x cap and one of the best RTPs we list at 97.17%. Free spins about once every 163 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.17% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
